453.h: Gerar University of Medical Science is a private university specialising in medicine and the health sciences. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
453.a: The university offers programmes in medicine and surgery and other health sciences.
453.c: It is located at Imope, in the Ijebu area of Ogun State, and provides on-campus hostel accommodation.

454.h: British Canadian University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
454.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes and emphasises health and fitness as part of student life.
454.c: It is located at Obufu, in Cross River State.

455.h: Hensard University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
455.a: The university offers a range of undergraduate programmes, with an emphasis on practical skills and ethics.
455.c: It is located at Toru-Orua, Bayelsa State.

456.h: Amaj University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
456.a: As a new university, it offers a small number of approved undergraduate programmes.
456.c: It is located in Kwali, in the Federal Capital Territory.

457.h: Phoenix University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
457.c: It is located at Agwada, Nasarawa State.

458.h: Wigwe University is a private university founded by Herbert Wigwe, the banker who led Access Holdings. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023, and the university held its first matriculation ceremony on 14 November 2024.
458.c: It is located in Isiokpo, in Ikwerre local government area of Rivers State, the founder's home town.

459.h: Hillside University of Science and Technology (HUST) is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
459.a: The university focuses on science and technology programmes.
459.c: It is located at Okemesi, Ekiti State.

460.h: University on the Niger (UniNiger) is a private university owned by the Anglican Diocese on the Niger, based in Onitsha. The National Universities Commission approved it to begin teaching in the 2023/2024 session with 20 degree programmes.
460.a: UniNiger started with 20 degree programmes across several faculties.
460.c: Its permanent site is at Umunya, in Oyi local government area of Anambra State.

461.h: Elrazi Medical University, Kano (EMUK) is a private medical university linked to Elrazi University in Sudan. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
461.a: The university offers medicine and health science programmes, with a curriculum aligned to National Universities Commission standards.
461.c: It is located at Yargaya, Kano State.

462.h: Venite University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
462.c: It is located in Iloro-Ekiti, Ekiti State.

463.h: Shanahan University is a private Catholic university established in 2023 by Valerian Maduka Okeke, Archbishop of the Catholic Archdiocese of Onitsha. It is named after Bishop Joseph Shanahan, the Irish missionary who led the Catholic mission in south-eastern Nigeria in the early twentieth century.
463.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes and is approved by the National Universities Commission.
463.c: It is located in Onitsha North local government area, Anambra State.

464.h: The Duke Medical University is a private university specialising in medicine and the health sciences. Its name recalls Duke Town, the historic name of part of Calabar. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
464.a: The university trains students in medicine and health sciences.
464.c: It is located in Calabar, Cross River State.

465.h: Mercy Medical University is a private medical university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
465.a: The university specialises in medicine and the health sciences.
465.c: It is located in Iwo, Osun State.

466.h: Cosmopolitan University, Abuja is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
466.a: As a new university, it offers a small number of approved undergraduate programmes.
466.c: It is located in Abuja, the Federal Capital Territory.

467.h: Miva Open University is a private online university established in 2023 by uLesson, the Nigerian education technology company.
467.a: Students study online rather than on a campus, which suits working adults and learners outside the major cities.
467.c: Its primary base is in Abuja.

468.h: Iconic Open University is a private open university approved by the National Universities Commission. The Commission records its establishment in 2023.
468.a: The university delivers its programmes by open and distance learning for school leavers, working professionals and lifelong learners.
468.c: It is based in Sokoto, Sokoto State.

469.h: West Midlands Open University is a private open university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
469.a: The university offers programmes by open and distance learning.
469.c: It is based in Ibadan, Oyo State.

470.h: Al-Muhibbah Open University is a private open university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
470.a: The university offers programmes by open and distance learning.
470.c: It is based in Abuja, the Federal Capital Territory.

471.h: El-Amin University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
471.a: As a new university, it offers a small number of approved undergraduate programmes.
471.c: It is located in Minna, Niger State.

472.h: The College of Petroleum and Energy Studies, Kaduna is a private degree-awarding institution listed by the National Universities Commission, which records its establishment in 2023.
472.a: As its name suggests, it focuses on petroleum and energy-related studies.
472.c: It is located in Kaduna State and offers hostel accommodation.

473.h: Jewel University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
473.c: It is located in Gombe, Gombe State.

474.h: Prime University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
474.c: It is located in Kuje Area Council, in the south of the Federal Capital Territory.

475.h: The Nigerian University of Technology and Management (NUTM) is a private university. It was set up in 2019 and the National Universities Commission records its licence in 2023.
475.a: NUTM provides education in science, technology, engineering, mathematics and management at undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral levels.
475.c: It is located in Apapa, Lagos.

476.h: Al-Bayan University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
476.c: It is located in Ankpa, Kogi State, and provides on-campus hostel accommodation.

477.h: Lighthouse University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2024.
477.c: It is located in Evbobanosa, Edo State.

478.h: The African University of Economics is a private university linked to the African School of Economics. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2024, and it held its first matriculation at its Nigerian campus in the Gudu district of Abuja.
478.a: The university focuses on economics and related social sciences.
478.c: It is located in Gudu, Abuja.

479.h: New City University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
479.a: The university aims to combine relevant curricula with hands-on skills drawn from teaching and research.
479.c: It is located in Ayetoro, Ogun State.

480.h: Eranova University is a private university; its name means 'new era'. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
480.a: The university focuses on leadership, economics and innovation.
480.c: It is located in Abuja, the Federal Capital Territory.

481.h: Minaret University is a private university established by the Ahmadiyya Muslim Jama'at of Nigeria. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
481.a: The university concentrates on agriculture, science and technology, which it sees as areas of particular educational need.
481.c: It is located in Ikirun, Osun State.

482.h: Abdulrasaq Abubakar Toyin University (AATU) is a private, non-profit university founded by Abdulrasaq Abubakar Toyin and licensed by the National Universities Commission, which records its establishment in 2025.
482.c: It is located in Ganmo, in Ifelodun local government area of Kwara State.
